transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together because we have an urgent situation. A former senior engineer left last week and is now working for a direct competitor, and we believe proprietary engineering materials may have been copied before their departure. We need to move quickly on an emergency court application, but as you all know, our pre-motion review routine requires me to get reports from each of you — litigation, forensic discovery, client-relations, and insurance counsel — before I can approve the application and its requested terms. So let's get started. I need each of you to walk me through your assessment so we can move forward as quickly as possible.
